explanation: The theorem says the fibre {h : H | h•x = h₀•x} has the same cardinality as the stabilizer of x in H, stated with Finset.filter and Fintype.card on subtypes. I searched Mathlib's GroupTheory and GroupAction files for stabilizer-cardinality lemmas, fibre-of-orbit-map lemmas and equivalences involving stabilizers. I found only the orbit–stabilizer lemmas (`MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group`, `MulAction.index_stabilizer`) and the class-formula lemmas. None of them states this fibre-cardinality fact or gives it in one or two lines.
